honestAssessment.note: Processed final batch of 47 entries: pidgins, creoles, archaic/proto-langs, Siberian languages, South Asian languages, Romance diaspora, and smaller regional languages. Most pidgins/creoles (Negerhollands, Negro Dutch, Skepi, Loucheux, Borgarmålet, Cypriot Maronite) and some smaller regional languages (Arin, Nivkh, Southern/Tundra Yukaghir, Palaung, Buwal, Cakfem-Mushere, Megleno-Romanian, Istro-Romanian, Tundra Yukaghir, Italian Eritrean, Jersey Dutch) marked WAITING due to having fewer than 25 verifiable real places where speakers historically live. Major pidgins/creoles (Russenorsk, Michif, Missingsch, Mediterranean Lingua Franca, Nootka Jargon, Solombala-English, Algonquian-Basque, Cappadocian Greek, Français Tirailleur, Waxiang, Xieheyu, Vedda, etc.) cleared synthetic 'town/sville/burg/view/side' patterns and any Caribbean/wrong-region place names, kept real place names where 25+ verified.
